name: list_reminders
summary: List reminders from Reminders.app. Returns each reminder's id for modify_reminder/complete_reminder/delete_reminder. By default only incomplete reminders are shown.

params.name: list
params.description: Restrict to one list by exact name. Omit for all lists.

name: add_reminder
summary: Create a reminder. Due day optional; add due_time for a timed alert, or give only due_date for an all-day reminder. STAGED; undo deletes the created reminder.

params.name: list
params.description: Exact name of the list to add to (e.g. "Reminders").

params.name: due_time
params.description: Optional time for the due date, 24-hour HH:MM. Requires due_date; without it the reminder is all-day.

name: modify_reminder
summary: Change a reminder by id (from list_reminders). Supply the new title; due date and notes change only if provided. STAGED; undo restores the prior values.

params.name: list
params.description: Exact name of the list the reminder lives in (from list_reminders).

params.name: title
params.description: New title (pass the current one unchanged if only changing the due date).

params.name: due_date
params.description: If given, sets a new due day (YYYY-MM-DD); if omitted, left unchanged.

params.name: due_time
params.description: Optional time for the new due date, 24-hour HH:MM. Requires due_date.

params.name: notes
params.description: If given, replaces the notes; if omitted, left unchanged.

name: complete_reminder
summary: Mark a reminder complete by id (from list_reminders). STAGED; undo marks it incomplete again.

params.name: list
params.description: Exact name of the list the reminder lives in (from list_reminders).

name: delete_reminder
summary: Delete a reminder by id (from list_reminders). STAGED; undo re-creates it from the details captured before deletion.

params.name: list
params.description: Exact name of the list the reminder lives in (from list_reminders).
